title: Papercusp Official: App
description: Whole-app template: a complete app on the papercusp data layer + operator-style UI closure, with a `target` decision point that selects the chassis — desktop (Tauri), web (Next.js standalone), or both from one codebase. The data and UI closure is identical either way. Add papercusp-ops-pots to the composition for an agent plane. Docs: /internal/docs on your install.
